Lux

the Lady of Luminosity
Mid laneSupport lane

Lux is actually played more as a support than in mid. She pokes from long range, catches enemies with Light Binding, shields her marksman and finishes kills with Final Spark from anywhere. She's a great support for new players who like dealing damage, but she's fragile and gets punished by hooks and engage.

When to pick Lux

✓ Safe blind pick

Her range keeps her safe in most lanes, but avoid her into hook supports if you can.

Pick into

  • Immobile bot lanes, like Ashe and Senna
  • Melee supports who need to walk up to you, like Swain
  • Teams that group in chokepoints, where Final Spark hits everyone
  • Bot lanes without hard engage

Avoid into

  • Hook supports like Blitzcrank
  • Long-range poke supports that outrange you, like Vel'Koz
  • Hard engage supports like Rell
  • Dive-heavy enemy teams where you'll be caught

Great teammates

XayahShe roots enemies you've slowed and kills anything you bind.
JhinHis long range follows up your binds from a distance.
Kai'SaShe dashes onto rooted targets for a quick kill.

Your team needs: A frontline that keeps enemies off you, and a marksman who can follow up on your roots.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge range: you can poke the enemy bot lane without getting close
  • Light Binding can catch two enemies and set up kills for your marksman
  • Prismatic Barrier shields your carry (and yourself) twice
  • Final Spark has a short cooldown and long range to finish fleeing enemies

Weaknesses

  • Very fragile: if a hook support catches you, you die
  • No escape besides Flash
  • When you miss Light Binding, you have little to protect your marksman
  • Lower win rate than in some other roles this patch; good engage supports punish you

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Light Binding + Lucent Singularity for your first pick
  • Level 6: Final Spark makes every root a likely kill
  • Support quest: World Atlas upgrades for free, usually into Zaz'Zak's Realmspike (or Celestial Opposition against heavy dive)
  • First item (Luden's Echo): poke damage and wave clear spike
  • Second item (Stormsurge): your combo kills squishy targets outright

Top tips

  • Max E first as support for poke and wave control
  • Stand behind minions against hook supports
  • Shield your ADC with W on the way out and the way back
  • Use 40-gold Control Wards from the support quest to control the river
  • Root first, then Final Spark: a rooted target can't dodge it
  • Heal your marksman when they're about to die
  • Take Celestial Opposition instead of Zaz'Zak's Realmspike if the enemy team has lots of dive
